description: Find events in Latvia (pasākumi Latvijā: concerts/koncerti, theatre/izrādes, exhibitions/izstādes, festivals, cinema/kino, kids' events/pasākumi bērniem, nightlife…) on a day or in a date range, optionally in one city, one category, matching words, free only, or from a time of day: 'kādi pasākumi notiek šodien?', 'what's on in Riga this weekend?'. With no dates it searches today in Riga time. The answer says today's date in Riga; showings that ended earlier today are left out. Results are in start-time order; for a short varied pick use suggest_events. Each event has its EventApp page (url) to cite, the start time with its offset, venue, city, price and the ticket link.

category.description: Category, in English or Latvian, any form: Music (concerts, koncerti), Theater (izrādes, teātris), Movie (cinema, kino), Comedy (stand-up), Dance (dejas), Exhibition (izstādes, muzeji), Festival (festivāli), Sports (sports), Food (degustācijas), Education (workshops, meistarklases, lekcijas), Family (kids, bērniem), Nightlife (ballītes, klubi), Market (tirdziņi). list_categories names them all.

city.description: City or town in Latvia (pilsēta), e.g. Rīga, Riga, Liepāja, Jūrmala, Cēsis. Diacritics optional. list_cities names them all.

date_from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Riga calendar day.

date_to.description: Last day, inclusive (at most 92 days after date_from). Omit for one day, YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Riga calendar day.

free_only.description: Only events known to be free of charge.

from_time.description: Only showings starting at or after this Riga clock time, HH:MM (e.g. 18:00 for 'this evening'). All-day events are kept.

limit.description: How many events to return (default 20, at most 50).

offset.description: Skip this many results; pass the previous answer's next_offset for the next page.

query.description: What to look for: a performer, a venue, a kind of event or a few of the person's own words, e.g. 'jazz', 'džezs', 'koncerti bērniem'. Latvian or English, any word form, diacritics optional; filler words ('in', 'events', 'kādi', 'notiek') are ignored, and a word naming a kind of event (koncerts, izrāde, kids) also matches that category.

when.description: A named window in Riga time: today, tomorrow, weekend (Friday to Sunday; on a weekend day, what is left of it), week (today to Sunday), upcoming (everything ahead). Overrides date_from/date_to.

name: search_events
title: Search events in Latvia
